settings.question: Does Scale-O require electricity or plumbing?
settings.answer: No. Scale-O is a salt-free water softener for overhead tanks that needs no electricity, wiring or plumber. Place the unit in your tank and use water as usual. Browse the full water softener for home range.

settings.question: Is Scale-O a salt-free water softener?
settings.answer: Yes. Scale-O is salt-free, with no salt bags, no refill hassle and no regeneration waste. Compare salt-free vs salt-based water softeners for Indian homes, or see water softener price and plans.

settings.question: Does Scale-O waste water like salt-based softeners?
settings.answer: No. Scale-O does not backwash or discharge water during regeneration. You get scale protection without the water wastage common in many salt-based systems. Read more in salt-free vs salt-based water softeners.

settings.question: How does the Scale-O trial / guarantee work?
settings.answer: Scale-O offers a 7-day risk-free trial so you can try salt-free hard-water protection at home. Guarantee activation is confirmed with your invoice. Chat on WhatsApp from this page if you need help choosing a tank size.

settings.question: What is Scale-O Mini salt-free water softener for 500L-750L tanks?
settings.answer: Scale-O Mini is a compact salt-free water softener designed for smaller overhead tanks (about 500L-750L). It helps reduce hard-water scale across taps, bathrooms and appliances without salt or electricity. Shop Scale-O Mini or compare all sizes in the water softener for home collection.

settings.question: Is Scale-O Mini right for my overhead tank size?
settings.answer: Choose Mini when your overhead tank is roughly 500L-750L. Larger tanks usually need Scale-O Semi (1000L-1500L) or Scale-O Centi (2000L-2500L). For two tanks, see water softener combo plans.

settings.question: How do I install Scale-O Mini in an overhead tank?
settings.answer: Open the tank, place Scale-O Mini inside, close the lid and use water as usual. No plumber or wiring. Learn more about overhead tank water softener installs for Indian homes.

settings.question: Will Scale-O Mini protect geysers, washing machines and bathrooms?
settings.answer: Yes. Once Mini is in the overhead tank, conditioned water can reach bathrooms, kitchen and appliances. Hard water can also affect hair feel; see hard water hair fall: breakage vs shedding.

settings.question: Mini vs Semi vs Centi: which salt-free softener should I buy?
settings.answer: Match tank capacity: Mini (500L-750L), Semi (1000L-1500L), Centi (2000L-2500L). Compare pricing on Water Softener Price and Plans.

settings.question: What is Scale-O Semi salt-free water softener for 1000L-1500L tanks?
settings.answer: Scale-O Semi is a salt-free water softener built for mid-size overhead tanks (about 1000L-1500L), common in many Indian homes. It helps reduce hard-water scale without salt, electricity or plumbing. View Scale-O Semi or the full water softener for home range.

settings.question: Is Scale-O Semi suitable for whole-house hard water protection?
settings.answer: Yes. Treating water at the overhead tank helps protect bathrooms, kitchen lines and appliances fed from that tank. For smaller tanks see Mini; for larger tanks see Centi.

settings.question: How is Scale-O Semi installed in an overhead tank?
settings.answer: DIY install: open the tank, place Semi inside, close and use water normally. No electrician or salt plant. Read our guide on overhead tank water softener setups.

settings.question: When should I choose Semi instead of Mini or Centi?
settings.answer: Pick Semi for ~1000L-1500L tanks. Prefer Mini for 500L-750L or Centi for 2000L-2500L. Need two tanks? Check combo softener plans and salt-free vs salt-based options.

settings.question: Does Scale-O Semi need maintenance or salt refills?
settings.answer: No daily salt refill or power. Units are typically exchanged on a scheduled cycle so protection stays consistent. See product details and water softener price and plans for exchange options.

settings.question: What is Scale-O Centi salt-free water softener for 2000L-2500L tanks?
settings.answer: Scale-O Centi is the larger salt-free water softener for bigger overhead tanks (about 2000L-2500L). It helps reduce hard-water scale across the home without salt or electricity. Shop Scale-O Centi or browse all water softeners.

settings.question: Is Centi the right overhead tank water softener for large homes?
settings.answer: Choose Centi when tank capacity is roughly 2000L-2500L or daily use is higher. Smaller homes often use Mini or Semi. Compare sizes on Water Softener Price and Plans.

settings.question: How do I install Scale-O Centi without a plumber?
settings.answer: Place Centi inside the overhead tank. No plumbing cut-in or electrical work. Learn more about overhead tank water softener installation for Indian houses.

settings.question: Will Centi help reduce scale on taps, tiles and appliances?
settings.answer: Centi helps reduce hard-water scale formation on fittings and water-using appliances fed from the treated tank. Pair with good habits at home; for hair concerns see hard water and hair fall.

settings.question: Centi vs Semi: which salt-free softener for my tank?
settings.answer: Semi fits ~1000L-1500L; Centi fits ~2000L-2500L. Undersizing reduces effectiveness. See Semi, Centi, and salt-free vs salt-based softeners.

settings.question: What is a Scale-O combo salt-free water softener for two tanks?
settings.answer: Combo packs include sized Scale-O units so you can protect two overhead tanks, useful for duplex homes or separate tank lines. Explore water softener combo plans and the water softener for home collection.

settings.question: How do I choose Mini, Semi or Centi sizes inside a combo?
settings.answer: Match each unit to each tank: Mini 500L-750L, Semi 1000L-1500L, Centi 2000L-2500L. Confirm tank capacities before you buy.

settings.question: Do combo units still install without electricity or salt?
settings.answer: Yes. Each unit is a salt-free, no-electricity softener placed in its tank. No shared salt plant or wiring. Compare technology in salt-free vs salt-based water softeners.

settings.question: Is a combo better than buying one large salt-based softener?
settings.answer: For homes with two overhead tanks, dedicated tank-level Scale-O units often fit Indian plumbing better than one bulky salt plant. See plans and pricing and overhead tank softener guidance.

settings.question: What is Scale-O and how does it work?
settings.answer: Scale-O is a salt-free water softener for Indian homes with overhead tanks. Place the compact unit inside your tank. As water flows through the home, it conditions minerals and helps reduce hard-water scale on pipes, fittings and household appliances, without salt, electricity or plumbing changes.

settings.question: Does a water softener reduce hair fall from hard water?
settings.answer: Hard water hair fall in India is often breakage from mineral film, not medical shedding. A salt-free water softener in the overhead tank can help hair feel less dry. Scale-O does not claim to stop balding. See hard water hair fall guide.

settings.question: Can I install a water softener in an overhead tank without a plumber?
settings.answer: Yes. Scale-O is a DIY water softener for overhead tanks: open the lid, place the unit inside, close and use water normally. No plumber, drain or electricity. Read the overhead tank water softener guide.

settings.question: Is Scale-O Mini enough for a 500 litre overhead tank?
settings.answer: Yes. Scale-O Mini is a salt-free water softener for 500L-750L overhead tanks, common in 1-3 member homes. If your tank is closer to 1000L, choose Semi instead.

settings.question: Which water softener is right for a 4 to 6 member family?
settings.answer: Most 4 to 6 member Indian homes with a 1000L-1500L overhead tank choose Scale-O Semi. Smaller 500L-750L tanks use Mini; 2000L+ tanks use Centi.

settings.question: Is Scale-O Centi right for a 2000 litre overhead tank?
settings.answer: Yes. Scale-O Centi is built for 2000L-2500L overhead tanks in larger homes with higher daily use. For 1000L-1500L tanks, see Semi.
